personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (Customer) + 7 Dark-First Utility structural principles for Worker Dashboard (implemented in Light mode for consistency)
personality_one_liner: A trustworthy, blue-first service platform that feels like a polished consumer app for customers, and a high-performance, high-contrast operational tool for workers.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content for Customer side. Tighter, high-density spacing for Worker side to minimize scroll and maximize action visibility.

do's: Sticky header backgrounds over scrolling content
dont's: Worker dashboard cards (use solid colors for clarity)

screens.name: Role Selector Entry
screens.purpose: A clean, trustworthy splash screen allowing users to pick their flow (Customer or Worker).
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse). Two large primary buttons at the bottom. English/Hindi language toggle in the top right header.

screens.name: Customer Home
screens.purpose: Discover services quickly via a grid and see AI booking entry points.
screens.layout: Sticky glass header with location selector. Top hero banner with promotional/trust messaging (dynamic). 4-column category grid (reduces vertical scrolling). Center FAB for 'AI Problem Report' overlapping the bottom tabs.

screens.name: Worker Dashboard
screens.purpose: Fast, high-contrast operational screen for workers to manage requests, active jobs, and earnings.

states.empty: 'No active jobs - Stay online to receive requests' illustration.

screens.layout: Status-led design (Uber Carbon app inspired). Top header with prominent Online/Offline toggle. Modular cards: Level 1 (Current Status), Level 2 (Active Job/New Request), Level 3 (Earnings summary). Large, easy-to-tap 'Arrived' or 'Accept' buttons.

screens.name: Live Service & SOS
screens.purpose: Track the worker's arrival and monitor active service progress, with one-tap safety access.
screens.layout: Map view covering top half (or full screen with bottom sheet). Bottom sheet showing worker details, OTP code, and live status timeline. Persistent red SOS button floating above the bottom sheet.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design exception: User explicitly requested a 'Blue-first' theme, so #2563EB is used as the primary brand color despite the general anti-pattern rule against blues. Do not change this.
Customer App Layout: Use a 4-column grid for the service categories on the home screen to match modern service apps (like Urban Company), reducing scroll fatigue.

Worker App Layout: Implement a modular, card-based system (inspired by Uber's Carbon architecture). Focus on progressive disclosure (Status -> Active Job -> Earnings) and large touch targets for use while moving.
Navigation: Ensure the 'Report a problem' button is a prominent center FAB (Floating Action Button) in the Customer app's bottom tab bar.
Safety Features: The SOS button must be clearly visible (using the 'error' red token) and accessible at all times during the active service phase.
Image Scrims: Any text overlaid on images (e.g., Role Selector screen) MUST have a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to ensure WCAG readability.
Haptics: Always trigger the respective haptic feedback listed in the JSON file on user interactions.
